hero.subtitle: BOOK A DEMO
hero.title: See your week in DFMG Platform
hero.body: 30 minutes, online, with someone who uses the system every day. We show you the parts that fit how your company works, on our test company. A question instead? Use the same form.

steps.title: We reply
steps.text: Within one working day, with a time that suits you.

steps.title: The demo
steps.text: The schedule, the employee app and a finished visit with photos, using made-up data. Bring the questions you'd ask any new system.

steps.title: A paid pilot
steps.text: If it fits, we set up your company in the platform and import your employees and clients from a spreadsheet. Your team starts in the app.

form.heading: Request a demo
form.intro: Tell us a little about your company, and we'll reply within one working day.
form.label_today: How do you plan the week today?
form.label_message: What would you like to see or ask? (optional)
form.placeholder_message: E.g. the schedule, the employee app, photos from every visit, the pilot…
form.privacy: We use your details only to answer you.

hero.subtitle: BOOK EN DEMO
hero.title: Se jeres uge i DFMG Platform
hero.body: 30 minutter, online, med en, der bruger systemet hver dag. Vi viser jer de dele, der passer til den måde, jeres virksomhed arbejder på, i vores testvirksomhed. Har I hellere et spørgsmål? Brug samme formular.

steps.title: Vi svarer
steps.text: Inden for 1 arbejdsdag, med et tidspunkt, der passer jer.

steps.title: Demoen
steps.text: Vagtplanen, medarbejder-appen og et færdigt besøg med billeder, vist med opdigtede data. Tag de spørgsmål med, I ville stille til ethvert nyt system.

steps.title: En betalt pilot
steps.text: Hvis det passer, opretter vi jeres virksomhed i platformen og importerer jeres medarbejdere og kunder fra et regneark. Holdet starter i appen.

form.heading: Bestil en demo
form.intro: Fortæl os lidt om jeres virksomhed, så svarer vi inden for 1 arbejdsdag.
form.label_today: Hvordan planlægger I ugen i dag?
form.label_message: Hvad vil I gerne se eller spørge om? (valgfrit)
form.placeholder_message: Fx vagtplanen, medarbejder-appen, billeder fra hvert besøg, piloten…
form.privacy: Vi bruger kun jeres oplysninger til at svare jer.
